queries.text: What brought the client in today?
queries.intent: Retrieve the smoke-free workplace change and request for help getting through work; exclude a presumed decision to quit.

Client allows possible persuasion and asks about aids that could increase willingness. This contributes no evidence to the defined question.
Clinician describes nicotine replacement and prescribed medicines as available options. This contributes no evidence to the defined question.
Client says they will do nothing today and views cessation tools as conditional future help. This contributes no evidence to the defined question.
Clinician asks what could increase readiness rather than claiming a plan exists. This contributes no evidence to the defined question.
Client says a friend quitting together might help but considers it unlikely soon. This contributes no evidence to the defined question.
